nodes.name: PR Search Divorce Properties1
nodes.notes: Set to Washington County, Utah (FIPS 49053) with a rolling 7-day window. The dedup node prevents re-processing the same records across daily runs. Adjust the date range (days: 7), county, or state as needed.

nodes.name: Deduplication1
nodes.notes: Tracks processed RadarIDs in workflow static data. Skips duplicates across runs.

nodes.name: Lead Scoring & Transform1
nodes.notes: Scores leads and maps PropertyRadar fields to GHL contact format. Adjust thresholds as needed.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ firstName: $json.firstName, lastName: $json.lastName, email: $json.email || undefined, phone: $json.phone || undefined, address1: $json.address1, city: $json.city, state: $json.state, postalCode: $json.postalCode, source: $json.source, tags: $json.tags, customFields: [ { key: 'property_value', field_value: String($json.estValue) }, { key: 'divorce_filing_date', field_value: $json.divorceFilingDate }, { key: 'radar_id', field_value: String($json.radarId) }, { key: 'county', field_value: $json.county }, { key: 'lead_score', field_value: String($json.leadScore) } ] }) }}

nodes.name: GHL Upsert Contact1
nodes.notes: ⚠️ CONFIGURE: Credential must be Header Auth with Name=Authorization, Value=Bearer YOUR_GHL_API_KEY. Custom field keys must match what you created in GHL.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ pipelineId: 'WKHzlpmkllZuR0QpQ7EB', stageId: 'YOUR_NEW_LEAD_STAGE_ID', contactId: $json.contact?.id || $json.id, name: $('Lead Scoring & Transform1').item.json.firstName + ' ' + $('Lead Scoring & Transform1').item.json.lastName + ' - Divorce Lead', monetaryValue: $('Lead Scoring & Transform1').item.json.estValue, source: 'PropertyRadar' }) }}
